ideas.title: The cart on a cord, retaken: a cord you can see and a clip that pops in frame
ideas.goal: The player switches the cart on and watches it drive off the pots under its own power, paying out a thick braided copper cord from a coil on the sand, until the cord comes taut and yanks its own clip off the pot: the cart coasts to a stop exactly where the cord's length says. The player chooses the cord length and the pulley; one cart stalls at the start, one arrives, and the clip decides where.
ideas.toward: The road step 'the cart: accumulator, motor and switch on the frame; it drives because the parts do' and the cartcord project; it is the first time the island's electricity moves a vehicle, and the retake of the missed post the human could not read.
ideas.idea: The existing simulation (physics/cartcord.jl: the drum motor's circuit with the cord's copper in it, a leather belt that slips by Euler-Eytelwein, a 12-particle rope tether pinned at the clip, rolling resistance on the oak planks) drives a cart whose cord is now drawn 3 mm thick and braided, lying in loops on the sand and lifting off them as it pays out. The camera stands still, low on the belt side, so the cart drives through the frame past the pots and the clip pops off in view.
ideas.form: A retake of the film in the same post (films/cart-on-a-cord.mp4), path traced 960x540, the cord and the coil drawn in plugins/cartcord.jl so the human's game shows them too.

ideas.title: Lumi winds the field coil with its beak
ideas.goal: The player sits Lumi at a winding jig: Lumi turns the crank with its beak, copper pays off a spool, and the turns lie down on the iron pole layer by layer, as many as the player stops at. Then the coil goes into the motor and the cart answers: too few turns crawl, too many starve on the pots. Winding is the craft; the cart is the test.
ideas.toward: The human's first item, the iron stator motor (projects/fieldcoil.md); it shows Lumi's hands working, which the human asked to see.
ideas.idea: physics/fieldcoil.jl already lays every turn (FieldCoil.path, layer on layer, wire length and resistance from them); the jig turns the pole piece on a spindle at the crank's rate and draws the path up to the length wound so far, with the free wire running from the spool to the contact point and Lumi's beak on the crank. The turn count goes into motor2d's ampere-turns.
ideas.form: A jig on the beach block and a film of Lumi winding, close and warm.

ideas.title: Iron filings show the field you wound
ideas.goal: The player sprinkles iron sand on a board over the wound pole pieces and switches the pots on: the grains jump up and line into arcs between the poles, crowding where the field is strong; wind more turns and the arcs tighten, saturate the iron and nothing more changes. The player reads their own coil by eye.
ideas.toward: Makes the iron stator's field visible: the player sees why one winding beats another before the cart drives.
ideas.idea: The FEM field of motor2d (Geo(field = true, NIf)) is sampled at each grain; grains are magnetic dipoles that align with B and are pulled up its gradient, with friction on the board (the ironsand toy's grains, now in a solved field instead of a point magnet).
ideas.form: A toy on the bench and a film from above: grains rising into lines as the switch closes.

ideas.title: The gear game: stall or arrive
ideas.goal: A mini game in the menu: the player picks a pulley and a gear for the cart, switches on, and the cart either stalls at the start, crawls, or arrives at the flag before the cord runs out. Three tries, three different answers, all from the physics.
ideas.toward: Turns the cart's real drive train into something a player plays with (the review's top finding: the player can touch none of it).
ideas.idea: physics/cartcord.jl's drive with the chosen ratio; the motor's stall torque against rolling and slope decides. The HUD shows only the motor's hum and the speed, not numbers.
ideas.form: A mini game in Jump in's menu, played with FakeInteraction for two gears that end differently.

ideas.title: Tug of war: the friends against the motor
ideas.goal: Three friends grab the cart's tail rope and pull backwards while the motor drives: whether the cart wins depends on the gear the player chose and how many friends join; the belt squeals and slips when they win.
ideas.toward: The friends and the cart together, the big goal's 'friends get off and push' in reverse.
ideas.idea: The friends' pull is their real gait force through a rope tether (Rope.Tether) at the cart's tail; the belt slips by Euler-Eytelwein, the motor stalls by its torque curve.
ideas.form: A creature interaction in the game and a short film.

ideas.title: The pots sag as the cart drives
ideas.goal: The player drives the cart again and again and watches the pots tire: the blue fades, the copper plate grows, the cart gets slower each run, and a rest overnight brings some of it back. Where to stop and rest becomes a choice.
ideas.toward: The road's 'cells that sag': the pots become a real store with a state.
ideas.idea: Polarisation from the ions that reach the plate (a diffusion layer in the pot's porous wall), copper deposited by Faraday's law; the circuit solver takes the sagging EMF.
ideas.form: A change to the pots, seen in their colour and the cart's speed.

ideas.title: Push the cart and its lamp lights
ideas.goal: At dusk the friends push the cart; the motor runs backwards as a dynamo and a thin iron wire at its front glows dull red, brighter the faster they push. The player finds how fast they must push to see the path.
ideas.toward: The road's 'the motor run backwards: a dynamo lights a wire'.
ideas.idea: The motor's back-EMF at the pushed speed drives a current through a hot wire whose resistance rises with temperature; its glow is a black body at the solved temperature.
ideas.form: A film at dusk, the wire's glow lighting the planks.

ideas.title: Lead plates fizz in the jar
ideas.goal: The player forms Planté plates: two lead strips in acid, charged and discharged again and again; each cycle they hold more, bubbles rise while they charge, and the cart runs longer on them.
ideas.idea: Lead oxide grows on one plate per forming cycle, capacity from the converted mass; gas evolution once charged as bubbles in the acid (Maelstrom's bubbles).
ideas.form: A jar on the bench, a film of the fizzing.

ideas.title: Lumi rides the cart and it stops
ideas.goal: Lumi climbs aboard; with its weight the cart stalls on the rise where it drove empty; a friend climbs off, or pushes, and it goes again. Who rides is the player's choice.
ideas.toward: The big goal's moment: stops short, the friends push.
ideas.idea: Real masses for riders (#745) on the cart's deck, the motor's stall against slope and rolling.

ideas.title: The coil heats until it smells
ideas.goal: The player runs the wound motor stalled; the coil warms by its own I squared R, the varnish browns, and too long scorches it: cooling breaks are part of using a motor.
ideas.toward: The cost of turns: the iron stator's limit.
ideas.idea: Heat in the coil from its resistance, conduction to the iron, cooling to the air; the varnish's colour follows the temperature.
ideas.form: The motor's coil on the bench, a traced close-up.
